```artifact
## UML Testing Profile (UTP)

**Test Suite Name:** U08_2 Database Performance and Usability Test Suite

**Target System:** Virtual Health Platform

**Test Objective:** Verify the database performance and usability of the Virtual Health Platform.

**Test Scope:**
- Database performance testing for 4.0 Million Consultation requests over 3 years.
- Usability testing for up to 5 specialities and mobile platform compatibility.

**Test Cases:**

**Test Case ID | Test Case Title | Requirement ID | Test Case Type | Preconditions | Inputs | Steps | Expected Results**
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---
TC-001 | Database Performance Test | VIRTUA-2.5-10 | Performance | - | - | Run database performance test for 4.0 Million Consultation requests over 3 years. | Response time within 5 seconds, no errors encountered.
TC-002 | Database Capacity Test | VIRTUA-2.5-12 | Boundary | - | - | Test database capacity with 3,999,999 Consultation requests. | Database functions without errors.
TC-003 | Database Capacity Test | VIRTUA-2.5-12 | Boundary | - | - | Test database capacity with 4,000,001 Consultation requests. | Database crashes or errors occur.
TC-004 | Mobile Platform Compatibility Test | VIRTUA-2.5-15 | Positive | - | - | Test system functionality on Android mobile platform. | System functions without errors.
TC-005 | User Interface Adaptability Test | VIRTUA-2.5-16 | Positive | - | - | Test user interface responsiveness across different screen sizes (small, medium, large) and resolutions (low, medium, high). | Interface adapts to different screen sizes and resolutions.
TC-006 | Usability Test | VIRTUA-2.5-17 | Usability | - | - | Conduct usability testing with different user groups for different specialities. | Feedback indicates ease of use and clear navigation.

```
